name: Sangre de Rosa
source:
Josephine is an amateur detective who feels that she is flawed and impure because of the way she is. Suddenly, someone sends her a picture of a dead body, challenging her to solve the case. It appears to be an impossible crime. As she investigates, she uncovers an unhealthy love story that makes her reflect on herself and the world, leading her to only one possible conclusion.

[Translated from [url=https://tompassel.itch.io/sangre-de-rosa]itch.io[/url]]
